items.title: Offer water to the rising Sun
steps: At sunrise, offer water to the Sun from a copper vessel.
items.why_template: {planet} is your {role}; a daily offering strengthens it.

items.title: Give wheat on Sundays
steps: On Sunday before sunset, give wheat to someone in need.

items.reason: With the Sun in the 1st, giving away its items is avoided.
items.alternative: Respect your father and offer water to the rising Sun instead.

items.prompt: Is the north side of your home free of heavy objects?
items.explanation: North is Mercury's zone, linked to communication and cash flow.
